purpose: Retrospective learned-sequence challenger for fixed-budget pre-move discovery; extends E2/E5 rather than claiming pre-move research is new.
universe: All non-stable, non-leveraged USDT spot instruments discoverable in the public Binance archive at collection time; current archive membership is retrospective, not a point-in-time universe.

periods.holdout: 2024 onward remains unopened; 2023 was previously studied by KOD and is not an untouched research holdout.

decision: After each completed UTC daily bar; all eligible rows ranked before any future-label availability filter.

eligibility.price_and_volume: valid positive OHLC and positive current volume; no future-based spike deletion

target.entry: next UTC day's open, used only for labels
target.first_passage: First future daily close crossing either barrier; classes up_first/down_first/neither. This is close-based, not intrabar execution.
target.censoring: Require all five consecutive future daily bars. Missing outcomes remain unknown, never negative. Unknown rows remain eligible for selection.

models.simple: Equal-weight within-day percentile ranks of volume ratio and 20-day volatility
models.g2: Existing E2 G2_RET30 flag first, then the same simple score; fixed-budget comparator, not E2's original trading policy
models.summary: Unweighted ridge logistic class models on causal summary features
models.sequence: Same summary features plus 8 PCA components of trailing 20-day normalized return/range/volume sequences; scaler/PCA trained only on train period
models.calibration: Each fitted model chooses scalar temperature from [0.5,1,2,4] by multiclass log loss in calibration period only

populations.early: same pool excluding ret1>=10% or ret5>=20%; fixed, past-only exclusion to separate early detection from chasing an existing move

evaluation.fit_purge: Only known labels with label_end_date <= period end enter training/calibration; no labels cross a fold boundary
metrics: selected known up hits / all selected (censored treated as non-hits, lower bound)
censored selection fraction and precision bounds
known event recall and missed events
Brier score and log loss on known outcomes
evaluation.episodes: Within each ticker, up-first hit dates no more than five days after an episode's first hit date share one episode; only episodes with eligible test decisions enter recall denominator.
evaluation.uncertainty: Paired 10-day moving-block bootstrap of daily shortlist hit-rate differences, 400 resamples, seed 20261030; sequence versus simple and summary reported separately.

limits: No profit or execution claims from forecast labels
Retrospective provider vintage, universe coverage and corporate-unit changes limit inference
Synthetic tests are not market evidence
No feature or parameter retuning on 2023 results
code_and_data: Every run records input hashes, protocol hash, source hashes, fit boundaries and model parameters; immutable publication.
